name: Quoridor (Declarative)
description: Race your pawn to the opposite edge. Move one square or place a wall each turn; walls may slow a rival but may never block every route.
rules: Race your pawn to the opposite edge. Move one square or place a wall each turn; walls may slow a rival but may never block every route.

tutorial.text: Race your pawn to the opposite edge. Move one square or place a wall each turn; walls may slow a rival but may never block every route.
tutorial.html:
Quoridor (Declarative)

Race your pawn to the opposite edge. Move one square or place a wall each turn; walls may slow a rival but may never block every route.

Choose Move pawn or Place wall, then tap a highlighted legal square or wall anchor. The board shows both pawns and all placed walls.
